rules.title: RevenueDot Kotlin Multiplatform SDK
rules.description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Kotlin Multiplatform SDK, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Add `implementation("{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-kmp-core:<version>")` in commonMain, plus `{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-kmp-ui` for paywalls. The artifact ids are the same as RevenueCat's.
Kotlin packages stay `com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.*`, so imports such as `import com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.Purchases` do not change.
RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, set `Purchases.proxyURL = "https://revenuedot.example.com"` before `Purchases.configure`.
Pass the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard to `PurchasesConfiguration`: appl_ on iOS and goog_ on Android.

rules.find: description.set("Mobile subscriptions in hours, not months.")

rules.replace:
id.set("revenuedot")
                        name.set("RevenueDot (fork of RevenueCat's MIT SDK)")
                        url.set("{{homepage}}")
